name: Tile-based Gaussian Rasterizer
definition: A tile-based rasterizer for Gaussian splats that pre-sorts primitives for an entire image to allow approximate alpha-blending for anisotropic splats, avoiding per-pixel sorting expenses and hard limits on blended primitives.
summary: The tile-based Gaussian rasterizer is a GPU-accelerated method that sorts primitives across tiles to enable arbitrary depth complexity without hard limits on blended primitives.
